data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-', meaning 'to support, sustain, or nourish'. In Islamic contexts, Namaa symbolizes the sustenance and care given by Allah and the importance of supporting one another in the faith. The name Namaa carries the meaning “Nourishment, Support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Namaa usually hope their child will grow to embody nourishment, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
